description: Original rendering specifications with attributed source references. Animation timings are authored, not measured.

catalog.label: Peony
catalog.geometry: Evenly distributed points on an expanding 3D spherical surface, not a screen-space disk.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Rapid opening, then deceleration and modest collective sag.
catalog.trail_rendering: None beyond a very short exposure-like glint; no persistent streaks.
catalog.color_behavior: One saturated color by default; a separate color-change modifier is permitted.

sound_design.signature: Single rounded aerial report; no automatic crackle, whistle or fizz.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Kiku/chrysanthemum and botan/peony agree on the trail distinction; a tailless star can still fall.

catalog.label: Chrysanthemum
catalog.geometry: Spherical array of radial heads, each leaving a visible spoke.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Fast round opening followed by gently curving descent.
catalog.trail_rendering: Fine continuous spark trails with separately aging sparks; heads remain identifiable.
catalog.branching: None; a spark tail is not secondary branching.
catalog.color_behavior: Warm trail plus optional colored tips; no mandatory crackle ending.

sound_design.signature: Single rounded aerial report; an unobtrusive airy tail is authored, not a distinct sourced sound.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Persistent trails distinguish chrysanthemum from the largely tailless peony.

catalog.label: Dahlia
catalog.geometry: Sparse, large, bright tailless points with clear gaps between petals.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Longer reach and longer readable points than the peony preset.
catalog.trail_rendering: No persistent trail in the base preset.
catalog.color_behavior: Prominent bright colored heads; optional contrasting independent core.

sound_design.signature: One aerial report; not intrinsically crackling.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Larger/brighter/fewer is relative, not an absolute star count or speed.

catalog.label: Diadem
catalog.geometry: Outer peony plus a tight inner cluster.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Outer sphere expands normally; core moves less and fades sooner.
catalog.trail_rendering: Inherit the outer bloom; compact core stays point-like.
catalog.color_behavior: Contrasting core; avoid compulsory strobe.

sound_design.signature: One shared aerial report, not one per core.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: An authored compact-core distinction based on HEX; other vendors use diadem much like pistil.

catalog.label: Pistil
catalog.geometry: Outer flower plus one smaller concentric spherical core.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Both layers begin together; inner layer has smaller radial reach.
catalog.trail_rendering: Independent trail choices per layer.
catalog.branching: No secondary burst; two star layers share one event center.
catalog.color_behavior: Clear inner/outer contrast; optional synchronized changes.

sound_design.signature: One aerial report for the whole bloom.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: A core modifier presented as a ready-to-use button, not a unique particle law.

catalog.label: Double pistil · Yaeshin
catalog.geometry: One outer flower plus two inner spherical cores: three visible layers in total.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Co-centered simultaneous opening with different expansion radii.
catalog.trail_rendering: Default tailless inner layers keep gaps readable; outer trail optional.
catalog.color_behavior: Three distinguishable layers; changes preserve layer identity.

sound_design.signature: One aerial report.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: An English preset label for two nested inner cores, not an asserted Japanese display classification.

catalog.label: Multi-pistil
catalog.geometry: Default one outer sphere plus three inner spherical cores; optionally four inner cores.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Precisely concentric expansion; preserve depth and similar overall extinction timing.
catalog.trail_rendering: Use restrained tails so successive cores do not merge into solid bloom.
catalog.color_behavior: Separate layer palettes; optionally stage a synchronized color transition for each layer.

sound_design.signature: One shared aerial report.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Three inner cores correspond to sanjushin; not three total spheres and not planar bullseye rings.

catalog.label: Willow
catalog.geometry: Broad globe opening into a loose umbrella of fine hanging branches.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Opening yields early to strong downward curvature; long descent remains visible.
catalog.trail_rendering: Long, thin, relatively dim warm amber/gold sparks.
catalog.color_behavior: Usually warm canopy in this preset; later tips are an optional variant.

sound_design.signature: One round report; optional very quiet airy decay is authored.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Western willow preset; Japanese yanagi can instead be a softly falling non-spherical cluster.

catalog.label: Brocade
catalog.geometry: Full umbrella with more densely textured hanging strands than the willow preset.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Rounded opening into slow cascading arcs.
catalog.trail_rendering: Fine gold glitter-like texture; brighter and fuller than the authored willow.
catalog.branching: No new shell breaks solely because it is brocade.
catalog.color_behavior: Warm gold with occasional pale flecks; optional colored tips.

sound_design.signature: One aerial report; glitter texture does not require loud crackle.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Brocade, crown, willow and kamuro overlap; the relative density is an authored visual distinction.

catalog.label: Kamuro
catalog.geometry: Large rounded canopy that closes into a hanging, bob-like curtain.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Long-lived heads descend substantially after the initial expansion.
catalog.trail_rendering: Long dense amber-to-silvery-gold trails with restrained twinkle.
catalog.color_behavior: Default subdued warm-gold canopy; contrasting pistil optional.

sound_design.signature: One aerial report, then space for the visible decay.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Modern Japanese usage often means nishiki-kamurogiku; kamuro and nishiki are overlapping names rather than universally separate types.

catalog.label: Nishiki kamuro
catalog.geometry: Same canopy topology as kamuro, with a brighter and fuller authored appearance.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Long fall; do not replace the descent with repeated explosions.
catalog.trail_rendering: Rich pale-gold/whitish sparkling trails, kept granular rather than a solid neon curtain.
catalog.branching: None unless a separately named finishing effect is added.
catalog.color_behavior: Brighter pale-gold canopy; optional white strobe tips are a variant.

sound_design.signature: One report; optional faint texture, not automatic crackle.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Nishiki is a preset label within the overlapping kamuro family. Hue and density are authored rather than matched to a particular maker's display.

catalog.label: Palm
catalog.geometry: A small number of broad fronds; optional rising trunk leads into the crown.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Bold outward motion then curved falling fronds; visible spaces between arms.
catalog.trail_rendering: Thick high-brightness trails, unlike willow filaments.
catalog.branching: None; optional small report accents are not part of the base preset.
catalog.color_behavior: Gold/silver fronds with optional colored ends.

sound_design.signature: One broad aerial report; ascent rush optional.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: APA describes six fronds, but this is not a universal count.

catalog.label: Spider
catalog.geometry: Sparse to moderate hard radial spokes with a jagged, fast opening.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Very fast outward travel; extinguish before substantial sag.
catalog.trail_rendering: Short-lived straight bright streaks, not long drooping palm fronds.
catalog.color_behavior: Bright warm or silver lines; tip change optional.

sound_design.signature: A sharp attack is an authored audio choice; no source specifies a unique spider timbre.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Flat trajectory means little visible curvature here, not a required 2D disk.

catalog.label: Horsetail
catalog.geometry: Compact one-sided plume rather than a full spherical flower.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Retained upward momentum turns over quickly into a tightly grouped fall.
catalog.trail_rendering: Long parallel-ish tails that remain near one another.
catalog.color_behavior: Gold/silver base; colored tips optional.

sound_design.signature: Softer release mapping than a hard spherical break; no measured loudness claim.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Wider falling plumes are often called aerial waterfalls; keep that variant distinct from waterfall-curtain.

catalog.label: Ring
catalog.geometry: Points on one planar expanding circle embedded in 3D.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Self-similar radial expansion, then modest sag and extinction.
catalog.trail_rendering: None or extremely short glints; a persistent connecting line is inappropriate.
catalog.color_behavior: Single or segmented color; multiple-ring variations are parameters.

sound_design.signature: One aerial report.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Frontal orientation is an authored legibility aid; rotated planes should project as ellipses.

catalog.label: Saturn
catalog.geometry: A planar outer ring around a smaller spherical central flower.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Ring and center open together with different radii.
catalog.trail_rendering: Mostly clean points; core trail texture optional.
catalog.branching: No new burst needed for the central sphere.
catalog.color_behavior: Contrasting ring and center, often a clean two-color reading.

sound_design.signature: One shared aerial report.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Ring-plus-pistil is supported at product level; final 3D proportions and orientation are authored.

catalog.label: Heart
catalog.geometry: An expanding planar heart outline, not a filled heart sprite.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Maintain lobe and notch separation during early expansion, then allow sag.
catalog.trail_rendering: Nearly tailless points to protect the silhouette.
catalog.color_behavior: One readable color; two-tone halves optional.

sound_design.signature: One aerial report.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: A recognized pattern family; exact shape and frontal presentation are authored.

catalog.label: Star (pattern)
catalog.geometry: Five-point star outline in a 3D plane, sampled along its perimeter.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Whole outline expands; avoid independent random speeds that erase the points.
catalog.trail_rendering: Nearly tailless.
catalog.color_behavior: Single color for legibility.

sound_design.signature: One aerial report.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: An authored five-point motif, not a reconstruction of a specific professional display.

catalog.label: Spiral
catalog.geometry: An expanding planar spiral curve made from stars.
catalog.motion_and_fall: The curve scales out; it is not a group of independently spinning tourbillons.
catalog.trail_rendering: Point-like or minimal tails.
catalog.color_behavior: Single spiral or alternating color sections.

sound_design.signature: One aerial report.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Lidu documents the pattern name; the curve and motion here are authored rather than matched to a recording.

catalog.label: Smiley
catalog.geometry: Outer circular face plus separate eye and mouth points.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Coherent expansion preserves face proportions before modest fall.
catalog.trail_rendering: Tailless by default.
catalog.color_behavior: Contrast features against outline; no filled emoji billboard.

sound_design.signature: One aerial report.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Pattern topology is supported; camera-facing presentation is a usability decision.

catalog.label: Crossette
catalog.geometry: Primary radial stars each divide into a small four-arm cross.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Parents travel first; daughters inherit position and some momentum, then separate.
catalog.trail_rendering: Medium parent trail, short clean daughter trails.
catalog.branching: One delayed four-way split per participating parent; stop parent emission at split.
catalog.color_behavior: Parent-to-child color transition optional.

sound_design.signature: Main report plus restrained synchronized split ticks; not a dense crackle bed.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: A plus-shaped original burst is not the defining event; the readable delayed subdivision is.

catalog.label: Crackle
catalog.geometry: A distributed field of tiny expanding sparklets and brief microflashes.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Follow parent stars or appear as terminal clusters; local microburst velocity is short-lived.
catalog.trail_rendering: Short bushy sparks; avoid permanent glowing branches.
catalog.branching: Local microbursts; a popcorn-style dark-to-flash ending is one variant.
catalog.color_behavior: Brief white/gold flashes and dim warm embers.

sound_design.signature: Dense irregular discrete pops; optional finer sizzling bed for rain-like variants.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Crackle, time rain and dragon eggs overlap; do not force all variants into the same timing.

catalog.label: Strobe
catalog.geometry: Ordinary sphere of heads whose brightness is time-modulated.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Continue head trajectories through dark phases rather than freezing or respawning them.
catalog.trail_rendering: Minimal trail so on/off heads stay distinct.
catalog.color_behavior: White or colored flashes; stagger phases across heads.

sound_design.signature: No automatic matching pop on each light pulse; aerial report only unless combined with crackle.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: HEX suggests 1–2 Hz; any animation rate is authored. Reduced-flash mode must suppress this effect rather than being advertised as universally safe.

catalog.label: Glitter
catalog.geometry: A tailed flower whose small trail sparks flash at different ages.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Heads follow normal arcs; glitter sparklets lag behind and fade.
catalog.trail_rendering: Sparse localized flashes within a granular trail, not head-wide on/off pulsing.
catalog.color_behavior: Gold/silver warm trails with optional colored steady heads.

sound_design.signature: Aerial report plus optional very quiet airy texture; no compulsory loud popcorn crackle.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: A trail-domain modifier presented as a preset; loose retail twinkle terminology can blur it with strobe.

catalog.label: Ghost
catalog.geometry: Clean spherical bloom with a color front moving across sectors.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Stars keep expanding continuously while their emission changes.
catalog.trail_rendering: Little persistent trail, so old colors do not obscure the phase front.
catalog.color_behavior: Segmented sweep A to B; optional short dark transition per sector; reverse or quadrant variants later.

sound_design.signature: One report; do not play a second explosion solely for a color transition.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Sweeper ghost is the stronger professional description; simple vanish/reappear may be a variant but not the whole definition.

catalog.label: Color change
catalog.geometry: Default peony sphere with a coherent color transition.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Continuous trajectories; color state advances with star age.
catalog.trail_rendering: Default tailless; trail color and head color can be independent in other bases.
catalog.color_behavior: Most heads change A to B together; allow a small authored age spread rather than arbitrary rainbow cycling.

sound_design.signature: One report with no extra bang at color change.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Modifier, not a new shell topology; contrasting colors present simultaneously are not the same as a temporal change.

catalog.label: Shell of shells · Senrin
catalog.geometry: Initial parent dispersion followed by many small spatially separated flower centers.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Child centers drift apart before their own local spherical expansions.
catalog.trail_rendering: Keep a readable gap before child blooms; each child has its own compact tail profile.
catalog.branching: Two visible levels: parent release then clustered child breaks; cap hierarchy at this level.
catalog.color_behavior: Child flowers may differ in color; senrin preset opens the small flowers near-simultaneously.

sound_design.signature: Initial report followed by a cluster of smaller reports, aligned with the visible child events.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Separate this spatial cluster from a serial multi-break effect along one continuing path; thousands is not a literal required count.

catalog.label: Falling leaves
catalog.geometry: A loose cloud of persistent colored points or tiny dashes.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Slow gravity-led descent with gentle correlated side-to-side flutter and shared wind.
catalog.trail_rendering: Almost none; do not make each leaf a long comet.
catalog.color_behavior: Sustained colored glow; optional twinkle rather than mandatory strobe.

sound_design.signature: Soft release mapping; no invented leaf rustle or compulsory buzzing.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Passive drift distinguishes the authored preset from active darting fish/bees; flutter details remain artistic.

catalog.label: Bees
catalog.geometry: Compact swarm of erratic small lights.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Short correlated turns and accelerations; no independent per-frame position noise.
catalog.trail_rendering: Short yellow/silver spark traces; individual paths remain visible.
catalog.color_behavior: Single light color or small mixed palette.

sound_design.signature: Soft release; an optional restrained buzzing hum is supported for hachi/hummer variants.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Western names overlap fish/spinners; a buzz is not guaranteed by every bees product.

catalog.label: Fish
catalog.geometry: Loose group of wriggling, independently moving lights.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Longer graceful darts than the authored bees; motion persists rather than passive leaf settling.
catalog.trail_rendering: Minimal short traces, not willow-like drapery.
catalog.color_behavior: Small colored or silver points.

sound_design.signature: Soft release; relatively restrained sound, no mandatory hum or whistle.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: The bees/fish size hierarchy is only one vendor usage; relative scale and smoothness are authored differentiators.

catalog.label: Tourbillon
catalog.geometry: Moving spinning spark sources with curled local traces.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Combine drift with rotating emission and irregular changes of direction.
catalog.trail_rendering: Short corkscrew/tumbling spray, not a static spiral-shaped arrangement.
catalog.branching: None unless a named finishing effect is added.
catalog.color_behavior: Gold/silver sprays by default.

sound_design.signature: Soft release and optional hummer buzz; not every tourbillon must whistle.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Accept tourbillion/tourbillions/turbillion aliases. Farfalle is related but not required as a separate button.

catalog.label: Comet
catalog.geometry: One rising bright head with a tail; no terminal spherical explosion by default.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Rise, decelerate, extinguish; slight arc or angled trajectory is an authored option.
catalog.trail_rendering: Thick continuous tail with individually decaying sparks.
catalog.color_behavior: Warm or silver tail; colored head; optional tailless pearl variant.

sound_design.signature: Short launch transient and restrained rush; whistle is an explicit optional variant.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: A comet can also be an ascent accessory to another effect. Do not make the standalone preset burst automatically.

catalog.label: Mine
catalog.geometry: A low broad cone or bouquet of many stars emerging together from the horizon.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Immediate upward spread followed by deceleration and fall; no high-altitude parent burst.
catalog.trail_rendering: Short clean star traces or a selected glitter/crackle texture.
catalog.color_behavior: Color cloud or layered bands; keep lower scene readable.

sound_design.signature: Short low launch thump/rush mapping; optional crackle inherits its own audio.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Ground-origin effect whose light moves into the air; not equivalent to a high aerial flower.

catalog.label: Fountain
catalog.geometry: Persistent upward spray from a fixed ground point.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Fresh sparks rise continuously while older sparks arc outward and descend.
catalog.trail_rendering: Moderate-lived granular sparks; brightness concentrated near emission.
catalog.branching: Continuous emission, not a chain of spherical bursts.
catalog.color_behavior: Gold/silver base with optional color pearls or crackle phases.

sound_design.signature: Continuous hiss/rush is an authored sound mapping; discrete crackle only when that variant is selected.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Gerb/fountain naming varies; this is a readable cascading fountain preset, not a hardware model.

catalog.label: Waterfall · Niagara
catalog.geometry: A fixed elevated horizontal band producing a curtain of downward sparks.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Continuous gravity-led fall from a stationary line with modest shared wind.
catalog.trail_rendering: Long thin descending spark strands; no giant central aerial break.
catalog.color_behavior: Silver-white or warm gold curtain.

sound_design.signature: Soft sustained hiss/rush mapping; no inherent aerial bang.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Waterfall can name either aerial falling stars or a suspended curtain; this preset uses the curtain form described by Pyrostar and JPA.

catalog.label: Roman candle
catalog.geometry: Repeated individual pearls/comets from the same scene anchor.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Each light has its own rise and extinction; optional bombette-style small terminal bloom later.
catalog.trail_rendering: Inherited from pearl/comet, not a new trail species.
catalog.branching: Repetition over time, not branching of one aerial star.
catalog.color_behavior: Alternate shot colors without recoloring previous live shots.

sound_design.signature: A sequence of small launch transients; only bombette variants add terminal reports.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Authored interval 0.6–1.0 seconds; this is an emitter sequence, not a unique burst shape.

catalog.label: Wheel
catalog.geometry: Fixed-center circular rotating pattern of spark emission.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Spark paths leave a turning source and then fall; the wheel center stays in place.
catalog.trail_rendering: Short arcs that reveal rotation without becoming a filled glowing disk.
catalog.color_behavior: Warm/silver rotating spokes; phases can change color.

sound_design.signature: Restrained sustained rush/hiss mapping; no continuous engine sound claim.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Do not confuse a ground wheel with a flying girandola. Angular speed is authored, not measured.

catalog.label: Set piece
catalog.geometry: Static arrangement of colored luminous points tracing a symbol, word or drawing.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Light holds in fixed world positions; add only tiny independent flicker.
catalog.trail_rendering: Little or no moving trail.
catalog.branching: None; many stationary light elements form one image.
catalog.color_behavior: Readable limited palette; simultaneous reveal and fade.

sound_design.signature: Quiet ambience or faint hiss mapping; no invented sequence of aerial reports.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: The button means lancework-like imagery; the broader term set piece can include other ground effects. Any lettering is original app artwork.

catalog.label: Salute
catalog.geometry: A brief compact flash with minimal persistent star structure.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Fast flash decays into a small dim smoke cue, rather than a large colorful bloom.
catalog.trail_rendering: None by default; sparse silver accents are an optional variant.
catalog.color_behavior: Brief warm-white flash, restrained screen bloom.

sound_design.signature: A dominant sharp report with authored low body and reverberant decay; relative loudness is compressed for comfortable playback.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Sound-first accent. Not all real salutes are visually identical, and no SPL or waveform was measured.

catalog.label: Fan
catalog.geometry: A spatial-temporal arrangement of multiple existing emitters or bursts.
catalog.motion_and_fall: Arrange paths across the lower/middle sky: simultaneous spread, left/right chase, center-out, or mirrored pairs.
catalog.trail_rendering: Inherited from the child effects; fan has no independent particle tail.
catalog.branching: No particle branching; it schedules separate effect events.
catalog.color_behavior: Use a limited palette per phrase rather than random full-spectrum shots.

sound_design.signature: Inherit child sounds at their event times; fan is not a new sound class.

authored_timing_seconds.clock: from visible break for aerial effects; first light for emitters

catalog.uncertainty_and_aliases: Keep outside burst geometry. V/W patterns and a Z/sweep are variants; authored fan-chase spacing can start at 0.10–0.25 seconds.
